description: This file defines the LDAPAuthProvider class which extends an abstract authentication provider to implement LDAP-based authentication. It manages LDAP service instances, synchronizes LDAP users, performs authentication through LDAP, and handles related credentials and exceptions.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\LDAP\Auth\LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A provider class that handles LDAP authentication by integrating LDAP services with the system's user management, extending an abstract auth provider class and implementing specific LDAP authentication logic.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPService, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPSyncService, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of AuthenticationService, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs LDAP authentication by validating user credentials against LDAP, using LDAP and sync services, managing exceptions, and returning a boolean result.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of this authentication provider, set to 5000.
